items: why the boiling point of $\text{ICl}$ is greater than $\text{Br}_2$
why the boiling point of $\text{IBr}$ is greater than $\text{ICl}$?

A.text: $\text{ICl}$ has stronger instantaneous dipole-induced dipoles; $\text{IBr}$ has stronger instantaneous dipole-induced dipoles

B.text: $\text{ICl}$ has permanent dipoles; $\text{IBr}$ has stronger instantaneous dipole-induced dipoles

C.text: $\text{ICl}$ has stronger instantaneous dipole-induced dipoles; $\text{IBr}$ has stronger permanent dipoles

D.text: $\text{ICl}$ has permanent dipoles; $\text{IBr}$ has stronger permanent dipoles
